caption: United States v. Smith
citation_line: United States v. Smith, No. 12-1516 (3d Cir. Aug. 6, 2013)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Cooper admitted evidence that the defendant had dealt drugs at the same location two years earlier to establish motive in a prosecution for threatening federal officers with a firearm; the jury convicted him.
qualification_rationale: The appeal is a substantial Third Circuit Rule 404(b) authority enforcing the requirement that relevance cannot depend on a forbidden propensity inference and clarifying the analysis trial courts must perform before admitting prior-act evidence.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit reversed the evidentiary ruling in a precedential opinion, vacated two convictions, and remanded for a new trial because the proposed chain of inferences depended on propensity.
